fusions.name: Plague Hop
fusions.desc: Sends a flea-ridden rat leaping onto one enemy, where it deals 12 damage and leaves it [Plague] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target then jump to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Itch and Scatter
fusions.desc: Shakes a cloud of fleas from your fur in a cone 4 tiles long that deals 7 damage to each enemy in it, with a 50% chance to leave each [Diseased] for 8 seconds. Costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Over Their Heads
fusions.desc: Leaps you instantly to a point up to 8 tiles away, with +10% dodge chance.

fusions.name: Carrier of the Pest
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. You have 8% poison resistance.
